card.title: The System Works
card.instruction: Celebrate every queue, delay, review, and formal approval as proof that a dependable system is protecting everyone from chaos.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two hours for our stall permit. Imagine how thoroughly they're checking things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The counter's empty. I need to get back to the shop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Nobody's being rushed into approving us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can apply online. It says there's a six-week review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Let's join that queue from home. Six weeks of protection, and you can keep the shop open.

mechanism: A celebrates waiting and an empty counter as protection, then welcomes a much longer online review while accommodating the shop's needs.
confusable: Unlike simply tolerating a queue, A must positively interpret delay and review as the system guarding against chaos.
comparison: The permit alternative chooses a longer remote queue to keep working; the street-party alternative releases tables to preserve approval-first ordering.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
